# Peptide Brand

> Peptide Brand connects research-use peptide brands with hundreds of vetted, USA-based, lab-created peptide manufacturers for wholesale sourcing, white label, and private label brand creation. All manufacturer introductions and consultations are 100% free — there is never a fee to connect with a supplier in the network. The network prioritizes 99%+ purity backed by third-party HPLC and LCMS testing and certificate of analysis (COA) documentation, with 1-on-1 support from first contact through fulfillment.

All information on this site concerns laboratory research-use-only supply chains: sourcing, documentation, packaging, and fulfillment operations. It is not intended for, and does not describe, human or animal consumption of any product.
